bio: A foal with a crank handle of a tail. Turn it and the foal starts, usually.
Half horse, half black car. It comes in any colour as long as it is black, and it is black.
An assembly line runs down its back and new horses roll off the end. They are all black and all the same.
note: Wanted a faster horse. Became one.
Doubled the pay and halved the day.
